body.statement: For empirical laws on a fixed finite alphabet, the multivariate central limit theorem holds for the cell-frequency vector; a continuously differentiable finite-dimensional map admits the usual delta-method linearization.

source.verbatim_statement: If r_n(T_n-theta) converges weakly to T, then r_n(phi(T_n)-phi(theta)) converges weakly to the derivative phi_theta(T).

attestation.note: Verified from the lawful PagePlace/Cambridge preview of van der Vaart, Theorem 3.1, pages 25–26; Proposition 2.27 on page 20 states the multivariate Lindeberg–Feller CLT for independent random vectors.
